description: Pump by Iguana, the winner of the PC demo competition at Euskal Party 1995, running from its original files in your browser.
about: Pump is Iguana's demo for MS-DOS, which won the PC demo competition at Euskal Party 1995, held from 12 to 15 October 1995 in Tolosa, in the Basque Country. Most of its low-level code was written before the party; the demo itself was designed, composed, coded and synchronized there, over 5 hours and then 28 more.
This is its release version, of 25 October 1995. It runs for a little over two minutes and returns to DOS by itself.
released: Euskal Party 1995: first in the PC demo competition, with 715 points. The release version is dated 25 October 1995.
credits: Code by Jare, Yann and Captain Bit; music by Noisy Man; graphics by Kronos and COI, 3D models by Iñaki. The DemoVT music system by JCAB; the PMODE/W extender by Tran and Daredevil.
terms: “This software can be freely distributed by anybody in unmodified form.” (PUMP.NFO)
accuracy: DosKit picks Run the demo in its setup, which has found the Gravis UltraSound. Its Sound Blaster choice has not been tried here.
DosKit sets WINDIR, as its README says to under Windows: without it, the demo runs at less than half its speed here.
Part by part, it keeps within 2 seconds of a real 486DX2-66 with a Gravis UltraSound.
Mono: js-dos mixes the two channels into one.
imageAlt: Iguana's logo in Pump, running in DosKit
